EthicsApprovals: As stated by the original PhysioNet release (Siena Scalp EEG Database 1.0.0, doi:10.13026/5d4a-j060): the Ethical Committee of the University of Siena approved the data in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki; at the time of admission at the clinics, each patient signed a written informed consent agreeing to the video registration and to the use of the data for a possible scientific divulgation.

sidecar.TaskDescription: Long-term video-EEG monitoring of patients with epilepsy at the Unit of Neurology and Neurophysiology of the University of Siena; seizures annotated in events.tsv.
sidecar.Instructions: Patients were asked to stay in bed as much as possible, either asleep or awake.
sidecar.ManufacturersModelName: EB Neuro and Natus Quantum LTM amplifiers (the release does not say which recording used which)
sidecar.CapManufacturersModelName: reusable silver/gold cup electrodes, no cap

participant_id.Description: Patient identifier of the PhysioNet release (PNxx), prefixed with sub-.

seizure_type.Description: Seizure type according to the International League Against Epilepsy (ILAE) classification, from subject_info.csv (seizure).

Levels.WIAS: focal onset without impaired awareness seizure

localization.Description: Localization of the epileptogenic zone, from subject_info.csv (localization).

lateralization.Description: Lateralization of the epileptogenic zone, from subject_info.csv (lateralization).

n_seizures.Description: Number of seizures of the patient, from subject_info.csv (number_seizures).

recording_minutes.Description: Total recording time of the patient, from subject_info.csv (rec_time_minutes).

eeg_channels.Description: Number of EEG channels of the patient's recordings, from subject_info.csv (eeg_channel).
